features.name: ALCops
features.description: New code analysis initiative that succeeds LinterCop, broken down into six different specialized code cops. Focuses on modernizing the approach to AL code analysis with separate cops for different domains.
caveats: Still in early stages
Not yet fully documented
Released this week so may contain bugs

features.name: LinterCop
features.description: Previous code analysis tool for AL that is being transitioned to ALCops. Had nearly 100 rules focused on code quality and cyclomatic complexity. Will continue to work but no new features will be implemented.
caveats: No longer receiving new features
Version compatibility issues with AL language 16.4
GitHub rate limit issues from May 2025
Deprecated repository - no new rules will be added
Will be maintained for a few more months through end of year

features.name: Platform Cop
features.description: One of the six specialized code cops in ALCops that focuses directly on the AL language itself without looking at Business Central implementation details.

features.name: GitHub rate limiting issue
features.description: In May 2025, GitHub updated rate limits for unauthorized requests from 60,000 to 60 requests per hour per public IP, causing LinterCop DLL file downloads to fail in DevOps pipelines.

features.name: AL language version compatibility
features.description: LinterCop has issues supporting AL language 16.4 because the VS Code marketplace only has 16.3, and dev tools have 16.2. Business Central 27.4 requires AL 16.4.

features.name: LinterCop trimmed down
features.description: LinterCop is now part of ALCops but has been trimmed down to focus solely on code quality rather than serving as a subscriber. Removed non-quality-related rules.

features.name: Test Automation Cop
features.description: A new separate code cop for test automation rules, developed based on community feedback. Includes rules like detecting unnecessary assert true statements. Still under development with more rules planned.
caveats: Rules for test automation still being developed
Currently has limited rule set
Approximately five rules created so far

features.name: Test dialogue validation rules
features.description: Planned diagnostics for test automation to validate that confirm dialogues are properly checked not just for existence but for their content. Will warn when test code validates dialogue presence but not dialogue content.
caveats: Not currently implemented
Still in planning stage

features.name: Documentation Cop
features.description: Code cop focused on AL documentation practices. Includes rules for code comments justifying commits and transaction boundaries between functions. Less focused on tooltips.

features.name: Formatting Cop
features.description: Code cop for code formatting standards and practices in AL code.

features.name: ApplicationCop
features.description: Code cop focused on coding standards specific to Business Central implementation. Covers rules like proper code unit implementation patterns and Business Central-specific coding standards.
caveats: Contains some UI-related rules that might be better separated
Possible future restructuring to separate UI rules

features.name: Comprehensive rule review and severity adjustment
features.description: All rules underwent intensive review for severity levels, enabled settings, and descriptions. Previous LinterCop restricted new rules to info level to avoid breaking pipelines. New ALCops architecture allows higher severity levels for better code quality enforcement.
caveats: Previous LinterCop limited new rules to info severity to avoid breaking existing pipelines

features.name: Expanded code fix implementation
features.description: Increased code fixes from approximately five or six to 30 total across all rules. Code fixes allow single-click automatic resolution of flagged issues. Some rules cannot have code fixes due to complexity.
caveats: Not all rules can have code fixes due to complexity
Some require Copilot or manual intervention

features.name: Improved rule descriptions for AI agents
features.description: All rule descriptions have been enhanced to be more understandable to AI agents and coding agents. Rule titles and messages in VS Code have been improved to provide better context for both humans and AI.

features.name: AI-assisted rule development approach
features.description: Used Copilot and cloud code to develop and improve ALCops. Evolved from manual copy-pasting to using AI agents with tools integration for more efficient development. Hybrid approach combining developer intent with AI assistance.

features.name: LinterCop to ALCops migration documentation
features.description: Provided documentation guide for users migrating from LinterCop to ALCops. Includes mapping of old LinterCop codes to new ALCops structure and documentation for existing rule sets.
caveats: 95 percent rule coverage, some rules still being migrated
Some rule implementations may need adjustment

features.name: ALCops deeper rule analysis
features.description: ALCops provides improved rule checking that goes deeper into AL code analysis than LinterCop, potentially surfacing new warnings on previously-resolved diagnostics.
caveats: May reveal previously-hidden issues
Requires validation that rule behaviors match expectations

features.name: ALCops VS Code extension
features.description: VS Code extension for ALCops that allows users to select and configure which code cops to run, supporting granular control over linting and formatting rules.
caveats: Cannot run LinterCop and ALCops simultaneously due to shared diagnostic IDs
LinterCop must be disabled in VS Code to use ALCops

features.name: ALCops MCP server
features.description: Model Context Protocol server for ALCops that enables coding agents to analyze code and apply quick fixes programmatically, integrating with cloud code and copilot CLI.
caveats: Early stage implementation
Still undergoing testing and improvement
Quick fix application mechanism recently changed from LLM-mediated to programmatic
MCP server is at version 0.1 alpha, version 1.0 expected in next couple of weeks

features.name: ALCops MCP quick fix automation
features.description: MCP server applies Microsoft-provided quick fixes directly via programmatic script rather than through LLM interpretation, preventing potential issues with code transformation.
caveats: Late change made to implementation
Still subject to testing and improvement

features.name: ALCops NuGet package distribution
features.description: ALCops now distributed via NuGet instead of direct GitHub releases, enabling easier installation as a dotnet tool and better version control in pipelines.
caveats: Replaces previous GitHub release-based distribution

features.name: ALCops semantic versioning
features.description: Implements semantic versioning for analyzers allowing pipelines to pin specific versions and gradually upgrade, preventing breaking changes from new rules.

features.name: Severity level configuration for new rules
features.description: Rules can be introduced with warning or error severity levels to prevent breaking pipelines, allowing users to choose which analyzer version to use.

features.name: Single Nougat package for multiple AL versions
features.description: One Nougat package file now works across all AL versions of Business Central by using reflection to target the same .NET framework version, eliminating the need to build separate DLLs for each version.
caveats: Uses reflection for version detection
Targeting same .NET version (8.0 for versions 16-17)

features.name: AL language version as primary driver
features.description: Changed from using VSX file version as the driver to using AL language version and target framework as the primary driver for version compatibility determination.

features.name: AL-Go helper for Nougat package installation
features.description: An AL-Go helper has been created to dynamically grab the correct Nougat feed and files for pipelines, defaulting to .NET 8.0 for version 16.0 or higher, with parameter support for earlier .NET Standard 2.1 versions.
caveats: Assumes version 16.0 or higher by default
May require custom implementation for some pipeline tools like ALOps or Alpaka

features.name: Dynamic transfer fields rule detection
features.description: An analyzer that dynamically detects transfer fields in code by parsing the base application and creating a JSON output showing source and target tables, replacing the previous static list of 200 hardcoded transfer field rule pairs.
caveats: Covers more scenarios and may throw new warnings or errors
Requires code analysis instead of text parsing
Analyzer must handle cryptically named variables and implicit transfers

features.name: Transfer fields analyzer
features.description: Custom analyzer that identifies transfer fields in AL code by parsing the base application and determining source and target tables. The analyzer creates JSON output mapping the source and target objects and their locations.
caveats: Analyzer must handle cryptically named variables and implicit transfers
Initial implementation was a quick solution with room for improvements

features.name: Transfer fields rule improvements
features.description: Enhanced transfer fields detection to support localization-specific fields, namespace handling, unidirectional coupling checks, and type-to-length analysis. Increased detected couplings from 200 to almost 400 across all versions and countries.
caveats: Improvements include handling of namespaces and unidirectional couplings
Split into two separate rules checking type versus object and field names

features.name: Try functions rule
features.description: Proposed rule to detect improper use of try functions in AL code, specifically identifying database modifications that are not rolled back within try functions. Implementation challenged by method chaining and external event subscribers.
caveats: Rule not yet implemented
Challenge of tracking method chaining across multiple levels
Difficulty determining if modifications occur within try function context
May raise false positives if external event subscribers are involved
Proposed to start with community discussion or GitHub issue

features.name: LinterCop deprecation
features.description: LinterCop repository is officially deprecated and will not receive new updates. The tool is currently on life support and will eventually be replaced by ALCops. Users are encouraged to migrate gradually.
caveats: LinterCop will be maintained for a few more months but no new rules will be added
Timeline is approximate; depends on breaking changes in Business Central
No exact end date specified for LinterCop support

features.name: Linter Cop Maintenance and Support Window
features.description: The speaker commits to maintaining Linter Cop for at least a few months to end of year to allow developers time to migrate to AL Cops. Internal company use and lack of migration to AL Ops yet requires continued support.
caveats: Difficult to set exact timeline
Depends on language evolution
May not resolve all problems

features.name: AL Cops Implicit Conversion Validation Rule
features.description: AL Cops includes a rule that validates implicit conversions between enum and option fields. The rule requires explicit conversion to integer type rather than allowing implicit conversion to prevent accidental wrong field assignments.
caveats: Applies to implicit enum to option conversions
May trigger on certain system tables
Pragma can be used to suppress the diagnostic

features.name: AL Cops Conversion Diagnostic for Error Prevention
features.description: The diagnostic rule helps developers prevent mistakes when converting enum values to option or integer fields by requiring explicit intent declaration. The warning works both ways - enum to option and integer to enum.
caveats: Not a hard prohibition
Designed to help catch accidental wrong field assignments
Developers can use pragmas to override
